> **Late Cancellation & Rescheduling.** If you cancel or reschedule a booked visit with less than 24
> hours' notice before its scheduled start time, we will charge **50% of that visit's price** to your
> saved payment method, to cover the wages already committed to the cleaner rostered for your visit.
> For a **first visit**, this 50% is calculated against the **first-visit price** (double the ongoing
> package price, since a first visit takes longer and is staffed accordingly) — not against the
> ongoing package price. This clause applies to every visit under an Essential, Signature or Reserve package,
> and to every visit under a signed Estate Care contract.
>
> **How it's charged.** The 50% late-cancellation charge is raised as its own invoice against the
> same saved card used for your booking, charged automatically at the time of the late cancellation
> or reschedule — it is not deducted from a future visit's charge.
>
> **What counts as 24 hours.** Measured from the moment you notify us — by phone, SMS, email, or
> through our booking system — to the scheduled start time of the visit being cancelled or
> rescheduled.

**Lockout.** If our team arrives at the scheduled time and can't get in (for example no key, a wrong
access code, or nobody home when you said someone would be), we'll try to contact you. If we still
can't get in, we'll charge **50% of that visit's price** (of the first-visit price for a first visit),
the same as a late cancellation, because the cleaner's time was already committed. Our team records
the attempt with a timestamped check-in and a photo.
